description: Failover policy and durable docs. (1) Timeout-class errors (TtfbTimeout, TotalTimeout, ChunkTimeout, upstream HTTP 504/524) fail over immediately instead of retrying the same provider. Live, each EH 504 at ~100 s was retried, which doubled latency and caused duplicate EH generations. 500/502/network errors keep max_retries_per_provider. (2) In route_request_streaming_excluding, pass-through TTFB timeout, send error and 5xx fallbacks record a ledger attempt and a breaker failure and exclude the failed provider:model from the buffered fallback, mirroring the existing 429 exclusion. (3) Add ADR docs/adr/0001, an AGENTS.md Non-Obvious-Patterns note naming the guard tests, and wiki updates. Implements plan.md items 11-14 and DD10-DD11. Depends on FEAT-001 (ChunkTimeout) and FEAT-002 (ledger).

In the dispatch_attempts_under_permit retry loop, after recording the ledger attempt, `return Err(..)` instead of `continue` for TTFB/total/chunk timeouts and HTTP 504/524. ITEM 11 (router.rs): module fn `is_timeout_class(&GatewayError) -> bool` (TtfbTimeout/TotalTimeout/ChunkTimeout, Provider{status_code: Some(504|524)}) next to attempt_status_for. In dispatch_attempts_under_permit, after record_try: the send() TTFB arm and the response.text() TotalTimeout arm now `return Err(err)`; the read_upstream_body Err arm returns when is_timeout_class (a Provider body-read error still `continue`s); the 'Retryable error' status arm returns for 504/524 with a warn 'Upstream gateway timeout, failing over without same-provider retry'. 500/502/network keep retries. The failover Err arm records the breaker failure as before (one per provider). Tests: timeout_class_errors_fail_over_without_same_provider_retry, upstream_504_fails_over_without_same_provider_retry, upstream_500_still_retries_same_provider (two MockServers a/b, max_retries_per_provider 1, backoff [0], helpers failover_pair_config/failover_pair_router/mount_streamed_turn), plus unit is_timeout_class_covers_router_timeouts_and_gateway_statuses.

ITEM 12 (router.rs route_request_streaming_excluding): `request_start` taken before the pass-through send. Send error -> Provider{"Request failed: ..", None} recorded with class network_error/502; TTFB -> TtfbTimeout recorded (ttfb_timeout/504); after the 429, context-length and image-strip handling, a 5xx -> Provider{"HTTP <code>: <body>", Some(code)} recorded (upstream_http_<code>). Each calls the new `Router::passthrough_fallback_excluding(request, exclude, active, &provider_model, failure)`: record_streaming_failure (breaker record_failure + provider health reason via friendly_failure_reason), handle.set_last_error, excluded = exclude + provider:model, Buffered(route_request_with_exclusions). 4xx keeps the old route_request fallback. ADDITION: when the exclusion leaves no candidate (route_request_with_exclusions returns InvalidRequest "No available providers for model"), the pass-through failure itself is returned (e.g. TTFB -> 504) instead of a misleading 400. Effect: a single-provider group no longer re-sends to the provider after a pass-through TTFB/send/5xx failure. Note: when the recorded failure opens the breaker, DD12 record_breaker_skips also adds a circuit_open_skip row for that provider on the fallback hop. Test streaming_ttfb_timeout_fallback_excludes_failed_provider (failure_threshold 1, a delayed 3 s with ttfb 1 s .expect(1), b serves the buffered fallback .expect(1); asserts Buffered, a ttfb_timeout ledger attempt, a's breaker Open).
